The '''Ord Ibanna system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Ibanna]] and was located within the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
